info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Mortgage Loans Rates-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Rates API provides access to current interest rates for various mortgage loan products. This API enables developers and financial institutions to obtain up-to-date pricing information to assist customers in making informed borrowing decisions. Typical consumers include mortgage brokers, banks, and real estate platforms looking to display competitive loan options. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their applications with real-time data on mortgage rates, improving user experience and engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve the interest rate for loans.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current interest rate applicable to loans. The rate is essential for borrowers to understand the cost of borrowing money. It is particularly useful for loan applications, financial planning, and comparison with other lenders.

requestBody.description: Request body required to fetch the interest rate for loans. It should contain relevant data fields necessary for processing the request.
